repository_note: Metadata only. The gate resolves the repository it judges run URLs against from the host (GITHUB_REPOSITORY, else the checkout origin remote); a file must never name the yardstick it is measured with. See scripts/lib/ci-latency-record-schema.harn.

budget_policy.$comment: A declared budget is a target, so it stays a stated number: derive it from the measurement and every job passes its own budget by construction and the gate stops being able to say anything. What is measured is recorded beside it. `observed_worst_green` is the evidence the target is judged against: a measurement above the target contradicts it, whatever the live sampling window happens to hold. A record below min_samples cannot do either job, because one slow run is a runner and one fast run is a warm cache.
